Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using immunoprecipitation of RING1B followed by LFQ analysis. While the biological context discusses ubiquitination (H2AK119ub1), the proteomics assay itself is an interactome study (AP-MS) and not a PTM-enrichment workflow for the ubiquitin remnant.

scope: To assay the RING1B protein interactome in MDA-MB-231 and T47D, we performed co-immunoprecipitations of endogenous RING1B-associated protein complexes using the anti-RING1B antibody used for ChIP-seq, followed by label-free quantitative liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS).
In IP experiments, extracts were combined with magnetic affinity medium (Thermo Fisher Scientific cat# 14301) coupled to anti-RING1B antibodies (MBL)
The bound fraction was released from IP/control experiments by the addition of 15 μl of 1× LDS sample buffer

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed specifically on material affinity-purified via immunoprecipitation of RING1B complexes. While the paper describes separate subcellular fractionation for western blotting, the MS analysis was conducted on the IP eluates.
